verdict.rationale: Twenty ships in-product AI agents, so an MCP-client capability is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows users can register external MCP servers for those agents to use. The pricing page's 'MCP server' row is about Twenty exposing its own server, which is the opposite role. App-defined agent tools are developer building blocks, not plugging in MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
